name: Motion Editor Online Control Surface
description: motion editor를 온라인 에디터 전제로 재구성해 코드 API, 온라인 workspace 저장, CLI 제어 표면을 같은 계약 위에 올린다.

userStories.title: workspace snapshot schema 정의
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a dedicated workspace snapshot schema so that portable composition documents and online editor state are modeled separately.
acceptanceCriteria: MotionWorkspaceSnapshotV1 또는 동등 계약이 document, source metadata, revision, editor-local preference boundary를 표현한다
composition document와 workspace snapshot의 책임 차이가 문서화된다
cd packages/motion-content && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/motion-content-editor && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run passes
userStories.notes: Target files: packages/motion-workspace/src/types.ts, packages/motion-workspace/src/index.ts, docs/specs/motion-content/v1-glossary-and-contracts.md. Keep motion-content focused on composition/runtime core.

userStories.title: workspace IO parse/serialize/validate 추가
userStories.description: As a developer, I want workspace IO helpers so that a workspace snapshot can be parsed, serialized, and validated consistently in every runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: 잘못된 schemaVersion과 누락 필드에 대한 테스트가 추가된다
composition document parser와 workspace parser가 분리된 entrypoint를 가진다
cd packages/motion-content && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/motion-content-editor && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run passes
userStories.notes: Target files: packages/motion-workspace/src/io.ts, packages/motion-workspace/src/index.ts, and matching tests. Keep composition document IO backward compatible in motion-content and add separate workspace entrypoints here.

userStories.title: workspace migration helper 추가
userStories.description: As a developer, I need workspace migration helpers so that legacy or future schema revisions can be upgraded without baking migration logic into the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: revision conflict 또는 unknown schemaVersion 입력에 대한 오류 shape가 정의된다
cd packages/motion-content && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/motion-content-editor && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run passes
userStories.notes: Target files: packages/motion-workspace/src/migrate.ts plus matching tests and exports in packages/motion-workspace/src/index.ts.

userStories.title: headless workspace controller 기본 API 추가
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a headless controller so that browser and CLI can load and save a workspace without depending on the DOM shell.
acceptanceCriteria: cd packages/motion-content && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/motion-content-editor && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run passes
userStories.notes: Target files: packages/motion-workspace/src/controller.ts and tests, update packages/motion-workspace/src/index.ts. Keep controller headless and free of DOM/browser globals.

userStories.title: controller command apply surface 추가
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the controller to apply editor commands so that CLI and browser code can mutate workspaces through the same orchestration layer.
acceptanceCriteria: controller가 set-parameter, update-item-timing, CRUD command, set-composition 적용을 지원한다
dirty, revision, checkpoint count를 읽을 수 있다
cd packages/motion-content && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/motion-content-editor && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run passes
userStories.notes: Target files: packages/motion-workspace/src/controller.ts plus tests, with reuse of motion-content history/state/session APIs. Do not invent a second mutation path.

userStories.title: typed workspace HTTP client CRUD 추가
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a typed workspace HTTP client so that browser and CLI can call the same online editor storage API for CRUD operations.
acceptanceCriteria: browser/Node에서 모두 사용할 수 있는 fetch 기반 구현이다
cd packages/motion-content && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/motion-content-editor && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run passes
userStories.notes: Target files: packages/motion-workspace-client/src/client.ts, packages/motion-workspace-client/src/types.ts, packages/motion-workspace-client/src/index.ts. Include tests for browser and Node usage assumptions.

userStories.title: typed workspace HTTP client apply-command/conflict 추가
userStories.description: As a developer, I want client-side apply-command and conflict handling so that optimistic concurrency is exposed consistently to browser and CLI callers.
acceptanceCriteria: revision 기반 optimistic concurrency 에러 shape를 노출한다
apply-command 및 conflict 단위 테스트가 추가된다
cd packages/motion-content && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/motion-content-editor && npx vitest run passes
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run passes
userStories.notes: Target files: packages/motion-workspace-client/src/client.ts and tests for conflict/error handling. Keep error shape serializable for CLI and browser display.
